decisions.reason: The coolant pressure booster extends the firm's core coolant management offer, carries invested development effort, and is publicly shown on the website, so it fits the firm's announced direction and there is no evidence of lasting failure.
The cleaning centrifuge supports the firm's stated sustainability and coolant management strategy and represents committed R&D investment, so management will persist with it.
The coolant nozzle line has several models and so a broad investment, and it complements the firm's coolant systems, which makes dropping it costly and hard to justify.
The scraper belt chip conveyor is central to the firm's established chip conveying business and is visibly marketed, so withdrawal is very unlikely.
The magnetic belt conveyor builds on the core conveying offer with a public commitment, and any early weakness can be attributed to the market cycle rather than the product.
The hinged belt chip conveyor is a staple of the firm's core portfolio with sunk investment and visible commitment, so management keeps it.
